question: In a certain code language, if QUIET is written as VRJUF, then how is TOUCH written in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/yPEmfy5LlCsMpORMCWdWwqP2v0JK3bc3JSYTud2cPK0ILJZ90tS0-2MP5nTNR4RaZrACIXdyVjAQPTbx4BQsN2dNgsdfic8ozNABjQu1Rq2vplj_vTZbiQnfnr2r_FLcAIyys-1c=s0] 

The pattern followed is:

**QUIET** is written as **VRJUF: **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/950db05d007edb8efb2d1727a7ff1d27f61a28b76511367f8c0187c9329730ed.png] 

Similarly, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73ad14c842eade090f5e81d7a90d8c012841b3dc3c907ed9d445c0d870404e2f.png] 

Thus **TOUCH** is written as **PUVID.**

Hence, **Option (2)** is correct.
